title: RelationTypeDeletePayload
description: Uses `id` (not `instanceId`) — relation-type definitions are package definitions, not instance-index members (ADR-009).

diagnostics.description: Notes, e.g., when the deleted definition's key remains resolvable through another installed definition or the embedded core package (srs-rust#995).

diagnosticsStructured.description: `diagnostics` as structured findings, entry for entry (ADR-057, srs-rust#1339).

DiagnosticPayload.description: One structured finding, beside the text `diagnostics` list on the render, find, container view, blueprint, navigation and type_schema surfaces (srs-rust#1491, ADR-057). Mirrors `diagnostic::Diagnostic`. `message` is the text-list entry verbatim.

code.description: The stable rule identifier, in today's spelling.
